integrity.scientific_provenance: Finite cubical computation and explicit rational rank proof reproduced from embedded standalone source.

limitations: Rational homology representations only; no integral H2 torsion, integral lattice, cohomology ring, fundamental group, or equivariant homotopy classification.
Results apply to exactly three unordered particles on the geometric complete bipartite K3,4.
Publication priority is assessed relative to inspected evidence and is not independently certified.
title: The full \(S_3\times S_4\) homology character of three unordered points on \(K_{3,4}\)
